description: Governed controlled vocabularies used across the ChatHealthy.ai system. Each vocabulary has a definition, members with definitions, and implementation traceability. Engineering operating rules (claude_operating_rules.xlsx, Version 4) are the authoritative standard per GOV-007 (Engineering Rules Are Standards). Vocabularies that duplicate v4 rules have been removed.

vocabularies.name: bad_data_reasons
vocabularies.definition: Controlled reasons for flagging a provider record as having data quality issues. A bad_data record has structural problems that make it unreliable for enrichment or user-facing queries. The record is retained but flagged.

members.definition: Provider has no practice address and no mailing address. Cannot be geocoded or county-enriched.
Provider has an address but it is demonstrably wrong. Zip/state mismatch detected and repair from license data failed for an unclassified reason.
Provider zip code maps to a different state than practice_address.state. License data was checked but did not resolve the conflict.
Zip/state mismatch detected. Provider has multiple license states — cannot determine which is correct.
Zip/state mismatch detected. Provider has no license data to use for repair.

source_files.note: Zip/state mismatch detection and license repair

vocabularies.name: out_of_scope_reasons
vocabularies.definition: Controlled reasons for marking a provider record as out of scope. An out_of_scope record is a valid, good-quality record that falls outside the current processing scope. It is not enriched or embedded but is not deleted.

members.definition: Provider NPI has been deactivated by CMS without subsequent reactivation. The provider is no longer active.
Provider practice address country is set and is not US. Valid provider but outside ChatHealthy.ai's geographic scope.

vocabularies.name: commit_prefixes
vocabularies.definition: Required prefixes on all git commit messages to indicate Claude's operating mode during the work.

members.definition: Claude operating in Normal mode -- standard behavior, best judgment, never break a rule.
Claude operating in Unattended mode -- autonomous, may terminate hung jobs, no secrets unless instructed.
Claude operating in Idiot mode -- step-by-step confirmation, one unit at a time.

vocabularies.name: feature_statuses
vocabularies.definition: Status values for features and test cases in QA reports and the agile backlog.

members.definition: Code exists but cannot be tested yet (dependency or tooling gap).
Intentionally postponed to a later sprint.
Must be resolved before any release.
